title: Shelf Stocking, Receiving/Storage/Holding Area (RSHA), and Custodial Operations at the Camp Pendleton MCB Commissary
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEFENSE COMMISSARY AGENCY  (DECA).DEFENSE COMMISSARY AGENCY
detail_text: Shelf Stocking, Receiving/Storage/Holding Area (RSHA), and Custodial Services at the Camp Pendleton MCB Commissary. The Government anticipates issuing a solicitation for shelf stocking, receiving/storage/holding area (RSHA), and custodial services at the Camp Pendleton MCB Commissary. The Contractor shall furnish all personnel, supervision, equipment, tools, supplies, materials, and other items and services necessary to perform these requirements. This notice is issued for informational and planning purposes only and does not constitute a solicitation. Solicitation documents and attachments will be released at a later date with the formal solicitation. This requirement was previously synopsized under Notice ID Number HQC00826RE0004, HQC00826QE0008, and will now be issued under HQC00826RE008. Note: This is a pre-solicitation notice (synopsis) and is not a solicitation. No proposals or quotes are being requested at this time. Attachments will be posted at the time the solicitation is posted. Place of Performance is at the Camp Pendleton MCB Commissary Located at Building 20850, Vandegrift Blvd, Camp Pendleton MCB, CA 92055-5212
